resources.string: E-Paper Launcher uses this accessibility service to apply a paper-style visual filter across your entire screen for reduced eye strain and an e-ink reading experience. The service detects app switches to trigger page-turn animations and renders the visual overlay. No screen content is read, stored, or transmitted.
E-Paper Launcher needs overlay permission to draw the paper-style filter on top of other apps. This enables the e-ink visual effect system-wide.
The accessibility service allows E-Paper Launcher to detect when you switch apps and apply smooth page-turn transitions, plus render the paper filter overlay.
For the full system-wide paper filter, E-Paper Launcher needs to capture your screen temporarily. All processing happens on-device in real-time—no frames are saved or sent anywhere.
